issues.description: The problem statement and UML explicitly require Farm to hold animals in a List implemented with an ArrayList (initialize the ArrayList in the no-arg constructor). The solution implementation instead uses a Set<Animal> (HashSet) for the animals collection. This deviates from the specified collection type and initialization approach and may confuse students about which collection to use and how to implement the constructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution follow the specification: change the Farm implementation to use a List<Animal> and initialize it as an ArrayList in the no-argument constructor (and update getter/setter types accordingly). Alternatively, if using a Set is intentional, update the problem statement and UML to specify a Set/HashSet so the expected design is consistent.
